description: This file defines React components for a tabbed UI interface using @radix-ui/react-tabs. It includes components for Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, and TabsContent, wrapping radix primitives and applying custom styles and class names.

methods.name: Tabs
methods.description: React component wrapping Radix UI Tabs Primitive Root with custom className and props.

methods.name: TabsList
methods.description: React component wrapping Radix UI Tabs Primitive List with styling for tab list container.

methods.name: TabsTrigger
methods.description: React component wrapping Radix UI Tabs Primitive Trigger with styling for individual tab triggers.

methods.name: TabsContent
methods.description: React component wrapping Radix UI Tabs Primitive Content with styling for tab content display.
